news.title: Metaplanet CEO breaks silence but shareholders say the hard questions remain unanswered
news.summary: Simon Gerovich said Metaplanet had not adequately explained the structure, and denied involvement in MMXX Ventures’ trading decisions.

news.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
news.summary: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

news.title: Polish prosecutors charge fifth suspect in a massive crypto probe
news.summary: BitBay became Zondacrypto in 2021. The exchange stopped trading in April after customers faced frozen withdrawals and estimated losses of at least $94 million.
